falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5650 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom pattern is broken; the 75% pattern match fails because the August bottom saw lower highs and contained rallies below prior breakdown levels. A breakout above 5650 invalidates the structural similarity and suggests a V-bottom rather than the drawn-out bottoming process implied by the pattern match.

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 41 implies elevated fear/uncertainty that typically persists through a bottoming phase. Sustained VIX compression below 14 would indicate fear has fully evacuated, contradicting the bottom-formation thesis which requires lingering uncertainty to build a durable base.

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve steepens by more than 40 basis points (e.g., from -50bps to -10bps or positive) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with gradual curve steepening as recession fears priced in. A violent steepening would signal bond market panic about growth collapse or inflation resurgence—dynamics inconsistent with the controlled, grinding bottom formation of the matched pattern.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
